criteria.name: Activity recency
levels: Over 24 months, archived, or not evidenced

criteria.name: Ownership clarity
levels: No owner, or owner has left
Accountable team + CODEOWNERS + 2 or more admins

criteria.name: Strategic and policy alignment
levels: Directly supports current policy or a published standard

criteria.name: Health and risk readiness
levels: No open high alerts; CI passing; README and licence present

criteria.name: Classification safety
levels: Conflict (e.g. public repo with sensitive marking)

gates.rule: C1 = 0 and C4 of 1 or less (stale or unevidenced, and not strategic)

Content owned by other organisations (i.AI, One Login, Digital Backbone): link from README or topics
Stale or superseded; README explains why and links to any replacement (GDS Way)
